Voxel Rush — a free browser shooter with tanks, helicopters and drones

A multiplayer voxel war game that starts in one click: no download, no launcher, no sign-up needed to try it. Fight 40-soldier battles for five flags, drive tanks, fly helicopters and FPV drones, lay mines on the crossings — or build a base and survive raids in the open world. It runs on PC and on phones.

Play now — free Join a FRONTLINE battle Team Deathmatch Open world

Three ways to play

FRONTLINE — battles for five flags

Two armies of twenty fight over five flags between their headquarters. Hold more flags and the enemy bleeds tickets; every death costs one. Pick a class on the deploy screen — Assault, Medic, Engineer, Grenadier, Recon or Support — and a place to land: the headquarters, a flag your side holds, or a free seat in a tank or a helicopter. Soldiers of the armies fill both sides, so a battle is full even at night; each person who joins takes a bot’s place.

Team Deathmatch — ten minutes in a desert town

Fifteen against fifteen in the streets, tunnels and rooftops of Sirocco. No vehicles, quick respawns, the most kills in ten minutes wins. Kill streaks, revenge and first-blood bonuses, a podium for the three best at the end.

Open world — build, trade, survive

A persistent survival world: mine and build with blocks, farm, fish, trade, buy weapons and vehicles, set up a base with friends and defend it from raids. Tanks, jets, helicopters, boats, artillery and air defence are all drivable.

What is in a battle

  • Tanks and attack helicopters at each headquarters — crew one with friends or deploy straight into a free seat
  • FPV drones for Recon and the Engineer: fly one into a tank or a trench
  • Anti-tank and anti-personnel mines: your own side passes over them, the enemy sets them off; a shot or a blast detonates any mine
  • Destructible voxel terrain: shells crater the ground and knock walls down
  • Six classes with their own kit, resupply at the depot and on your flags, revive the wounded
  • Five maps in rotation — River Crossing, Kavir Citadel, Frozen Harbor, Fallen City and Cosmodrome — and a vote for the next one after every round
  • Your side is always blue and the enemy always red, whichever army you are in
  • Voice chat and team chat, squads with friends
  • Round pay, daily rewards, weapon and armour finishes to collect
  • English and Russian, mouse and keyboard or touch controls; installs as an app from the browser

Questions

Is Voxel Rush free?

Yes. The game is free to play in the browser. Cosmetic finishes can be earned in play.

Do I need to download or install anything?

No. Open play.voxelrush.app and press Play. A modern browser with WebGL 2 is enough — Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. You can also install it as an app from the browser menu.

Does it work on a phone?

Yes. There are touch controls for Android and iPhone, with layouts for both orientations.

Do I need an account?

No. You can join as a guest in one click. An account keeps your progress, rewards and finishes across devices.

Can I play with friends?

Yes. Send them the link, add each other as friends, form a squad and join the same battle; there is voice chat with your side.

Is it like Minecraft or like Battlefield?

Both. The open world is a block-building survival game; FRONTLINE and Team Deathmatch are team shooters played on voxel maps with vehicles and destruction.
